artists.biography: Monster Magnet is an American stoner rock band. Hailing from Red Bank, New Jersey, the group was founded by Dave Wyndorf (vocals and guitar), John McBain (guitar) and Tim Cronin (vocals and drums). The band first went by the names "Dog of Mystery", "Airport 75", "Triple Bad Acid" and "King Fuzz" before finally settling on "Monster Magnet", taken from the name of a 1960s toy made by Wham-O, which Wyndorf liked when he was a child.

perplexity.description:
Milking The Stars: A Re-Imagining Of Last Patrol" is a 2014 remix album by American rock band Monster Magnet, released on November 14 through Napalm Records. It serves as a reimagined version of their 2013 album "Last Patrol," featuring reworked tracks alongside four new songs and two live recordings. The album continues Monster Magnet's exploration of stoner and psychedelic hard rock, blending heavy riffs with spacey, atmospheric elements that characterize their sound.

Positioned after "Last Patrol" in the band's discography, "Milking The Stars" reflects frontman Dave Wyndorf's intent to revisit and expand upon the previous album's material, offering a fresh perspective while maintaining the band's signature style. Critically, the album was well received within the stoner rock community, noted for its creative reinterpretations and solid musicianship, earning positive reviews such as an 8/10 rating from Reflections of Darkness. It reinforces Monster Magnet's status as a key influence in the psychedelic and stoner rock genres, alongside peers like Kyuss and Queens of the Stone Age.
